benefit: Radish flowers strongly attract striped cucumber beetle adults and can be flame-killed or pulled when beetles arrive in numbers. Reduces direct feeding pressure and bacterial wilt vectoring on cucurbit foliage.

members.title: Bolted radish trap at cucurbit emergence
members.body: Direct-sow radish 3 weeks before cucurbit planting at the row ends. Let the radish bolt and bloom; pull or torch heavily-infested plants before seed-set.
